1. Engagement Scope

The scope of this review was to assess the design and operational effectiveness of Newbury Group's compliance program related to anti-bribery and corruption regulations, including the FCPA and UK Bribery Act. The assessment included a review of policies, training records for 190 employees, and a sample of 25 third-party vendor payments.

2. Methodology

The assessment of {org}'s compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) included a review of {n} job descriptions to ensure essential functions were clearly defined and not unnecessarily exclusionary.

4. Detailed Findings
CRP-6337-001INFORMATIONALMONITORING
Observation

System access for 190 terminated employees not revoked within the 24-hour SLA defined by IT security policy

Corrective Action Required

All managers will be required to complete a biennial training course on disability awareness and the ADA interactive process, with completion rates reported to the Chief Diversity Officer.

Management Response

The condition identified has been partially remediated. Newbury Group has addressed the majority of the affected population and is on track for full closure by the due date. A status update will be provided at the next scheduled review.

Owner: Chief Executive Officer • Due: 2009-01-28
CRP-5628-002INFORMATIONALREMEDIATED
Observation

Dodd-Frank §954 clawback policy not triggered for 190 executives following a material financial restatement

Corrective Action Required

Implement a "Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information" link on all internal and external career pages and establish a process for responding to employee data requests under CCPA/CPRA.

Management Response

Management accepts the finding. The relevant system configuration has been updated, and the change will be deployed to production during the next scheduled release on 2008-10-02.

Owner: Associate, Research & Analytics • Due: 2009-01-28
CRP-1712-003INFORMATIONALREMEDIATED
Observation

Salary range disclosure missing from 10% of job postings in jurisdictions requiring it

Corrective Action Required

Recruiting and HR staff will undergo mandatory training on prohibited salary history inquiries, with training completion tracked and certified.

Management Response

The finding is accepted. We have implemented a manual control as an interim solution while a permanent system fix is being developed. The manual control is performed daily by the compliance team.

Owner: Chief Supply Chain Officer • Due: 2009-01-28
CRP-6501-004LOWMONITORING
Observation

OFCCP affirmative action plan goals not updated for the current plan year

Corrective Action Required

The IT department will roll out mandatory end-to-end encryption for all emails containing sensitive employee data, including benefits and health information.

Management Response

Management has implemented a compensating control that reduces the residual risk of this finding to an acceptable level. The original control deficiency will be addressed as part of the Q4 2010 system upgrade. We request this finding be downgraded to "INFORMATIONAL".

Owner: Manager of Sustainability Programs • Due: 2008-12-28
CRP-3214-005LOWOPEN
Observation

WARN Act notification timeline not met for 190 affected employees in 3 reduction-in-force

Corrective Action Required

A standardized process will be implemented to respond to all formal union information requests within 10 business days, with all responses reviewed by labor relations counsel.

Management Response

The condition identified has been partially remediated. Newbury Group has addressed the majority of the affected population and is on track for full closure by the due date. A status update will be provided at the next scheduled review.

Owner: Office Manager • Due: 2008-11-28
CRP-6900-006INFORMATIONALOPEN
Observation

PCAOB Auditing Standard No. 18 requires disclosure of related party transactions not found in the 2008 10-K

Corrective Action Required

The company website and all subsidiary career sites will be updated to include a compliant "Your Privacy Choices" link, and a dedicated internal team will be trained to handle data subject requests.

Management Response

Management acknowledges the finding and has initiated a preliminary review. The designated owner will oversee remediation. Newbury Group requests a 30-day extension to the original due date to allow for thorough analysis across all affected locations.

Owner: Senior Director of Business Development • Due: 2009-02-28
